blocks.orig: A balloon safari in the iconic Serengeti National Park will make your Tanzania safari a memorable experience. You rise at sunrise and gently fly over the endless plains of the Serengeti. The hot air balloon floats at treetop height above the baobabs and acacias so that you can see the animals nearby. Watching the wildlife below from your balloon is a fascinating and peaceful experience that comes with breathtaking panoramic views.
blocks.html: Floating over the famous Serengeti National Park in a balloon is one of those moments that stays with you long after your Tanzania safari is over. You lift off as the sun comes up and drift quietly across the Serengeti's seemingly endless plains. The balloon hovers just above the tops of the baobabs and acacias, close enough for you to pick out the animals below. Observing wildlife from the basket, in near silence and with wide views in every direction, is both calming and captivating.

blocks.orig: Duration of the balloon flight: 45-60 mins
blocks.html: Flight time in the balloon: 45-60 mins

blocks.orig: Total duration: 3-4 hours (incl. pickup, flight, bush breakfast and drop off)
blocks.html: From door to door: 3-4 hours (pickup, the flight itself, a bush breakfast and the return transfer)

blocks.orig: Clothes: preferably warmer clothes for the early morning
blocks.html: What to wear: warm layers are a good idea, as early mornings are chilly

blocks.orig: Weight limit: typically 120 kg per person; extra seat may be required if exceeded
blocks.html: Maximum weight: as a rule 120 kg per passenger; anyone heavier may have to book a second seat
